title: Finding a photo by searching
drDigitalIntro:
When you have hundreds of photos, Search is the fastest way to find what you need.
• Type a word like 'dog' or 'beach' and matching photos appear instantly.
• Real photo apps also recognize faces — name someone once, and the app finds every photo of them.
• Find one photo below by searching for it.

playgroundTask.goal: You found a photo by searching

steps.say: Click the search icon to open the search bar.
Type 'dog' to find all dog photos.
Click the Dog at the Park photo to open it.
Mark this one as a favorite so you can find it quickly later.

drDigitalSuccess: You found it by searching instead of scrolling. Photo search reads names, places, and often what is actually in the picture.
drDigitalHint: Click the search icon in the sidebar, type 'dog', then open the photo and mark it as a favorite.
